texts.li: {A_nameDef} looked up from {A_possessive} work and found {X_indefinite} sitting on a rock a few paces off, watching with great interest. When {A_nameDef} waved, it tilted its head.
{A_nameDef} had the feeling of being watched for a long while before catching {X_definite} peering out of the long grass. It ducked out of sight, then peered out again.
While {A_nameDef} worked, {X_indefinite} crept closer and closer, until it was near enough to sniff {A_possessive} boot. Then it bolted, very pleased with itself.
{A_nameDef} looked twice at {X_indefinite} in the grass. It was the wrong color, and its coat caught the light like a new coin. {A_nameDef} stood very still and didn't breathe until it moved on.
Past the fields, the grass sparkled. When {A_nameDef} went to look, {A_pronoun} found {X_indefinite} unlike any {A_pronoun} had ever seen, shining as if someone had painted it.
[snow] Against the snow {X_indefinite} shone so brightly that {A_nameDef} saw it from across the field. {A_pronoun} watched it until it went into the trees.
{A_nameDef} saw {X_indefinite} with a coat of the wrong color, bright as polished metal, and talked about nothing else for the rest of the day.
Far off on the ridge, {A_nameDef} saw {X_indefinite} crossing, unhurried, the kind trainers talk about for years. {A_nameDef} watched until it was out of sight.
{A_nameDef} came back from the fields out of breath, having seen {X_indefinite} drinking at the water as calmly as a goat. By the time anyone else looked, it had gone into the trees.
[evening] At dusk {A_nameDef} saw {X_indefinite} at the edge of the trees, the kind of Pokémon most trainers only hear about. It looked back at {A_objective} for a long moment and left.
{A_nameDef} kept very still while {X_indefinite} crossed the open ground nearby, and watched how it moved and where it stopped to look around.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: a child and a small Pokémon

texts.li: {A_nameDef} sat very still at the edge of the field holding out a berry, and after a long while {X_indefinite} came and took it from {A_possessive} hand. {A_nameDef} hasn't stopped talking about it.
{A_nameDef} and {X_indefinite} played chase along the fence for a long while, taking turns at being chased.
{A_nameDef} found {X_indefinite} hiding in the long grass and lay down on {A_possessive} stomach to watch it. They stared at each other for a long time before it wandered off.
[rain] {A_nameDef} and {X_indefinite} both ran for the same bit of shelter when the rain started, and waited it out side by side.
{A_nameDef} was working alone when {A_possessive} Pokémon, {X_nameDef}, came and settled beside {A_objective}, just to be near. They stayed like that for a long while.
{X_nameDef} has learned the sound of {A_nameDef}'s footsteps, and comes running every time, whatever it was doing.
{A_nameDef} sat down after a long day and {X_nameDef} climbed into {A_possessive} lap, which it has been too big to do for some time. {A_nameDef} didn't have the heart to say so.
